items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Save The Date
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag findet im Juni in Berlin statt.

items.title: Three people injured in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, including two children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in the Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia has risen to three, including two children.

items.title: War update: 116 clashes on front line, Russian forces pressing hardest in Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka sectors
items.teaser: A total of 116 combat engagements took place along the front line, with Russian forces launching nearly 25 assaults on Ukrainian positions in the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kryvyi Rih rises to 73, including nine children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in yesterday’s Russian attack on Kryvyi Rih has risen to 73, including nine children.

items.title: Ukraine, UK agree to jointly produce Ukrainian middle- and deep-strike drones in Britain
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and UK Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting have signed project agreements on the joint production of Ukrainian middle-strike and deep-strike drones.

items.title: Explosions heard in Zaporizhzhia, traffic completely halted on bridges and DniproHES dam
items.teaser: A series of explosions was heard in Zaporizhzhia, and all traffic across the bridges and the DniproHES dam has been completely suspended.

items.title: Russisches Militär greift Bahnhof in Region Schytomyr an, es gibt einen Verletzten
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben einen Bahnhof in der Gemeinde Owrutsch in der Oblast Schytomyr angegriffen. Eine Zivilperson wurde verletzt.

items.title: Airport in Russia’s Kaliningrad region temporarily closed amid drone threat – social media
items.teaser: Khrabrovo Airport in Russia’s Kaliningrad temporarily suspended arrivals and departures.

items.title: Explosions reported near Russian Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad Oblast amid drone alerts
items.teaser: Ukrainian monitoring channel WarTranslated, citing Russian accounts, reported claims that drones were attacking the Baltic Fleet base in Baltiysk. The channel also relayed unverified suggestions that the drones may have been launched from a vessel.

items.title: Ukrainian mid- and long-range strike drones to be produced in UK
items.teaser: Ukraine and the UK have signed agreements on the production of Ukrainian middle- and deep-strike drones in Britain with UK funding to supply Ukraine's defence forces.

items.title: Prague pays tribute to Ukrainians who died for freedom
items.teaser: Members of the Ukrainian community and diplomats in Prague paid tribute to fellow Ukrainians who gave their lives for the freedom and future of Ukraine.

items.title: „Moralische Katastrophe“: Mehrheit der Russen sieht bei ihrem Land keine Verantwortung für Zerstörung der Ukraine
items.teaser: Eine überwiegende Mehrheit der Russen meint, ihr Land sei weder für die Zerstörungen in der Ukraine, noch dafür, dass die Bewohner großer Städte infolge russischer Luftangruffe täglich durchschnittlich 6 bis 12 Stunden ohne Strom oder Wasser auskommen müssen, verantwortlich.

items.title: Russian forces launch nearly 30 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring five
items.teaser: Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks on six districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring five civilians.

items.title: Kiew: Schwieriger Alltag nach russischem Beschuss
items.teaser: Russische Angriffe haben in Kiew mehrere Brücken über den Dnipro beschädigt. Das macht den Alltag im Krieg noch schwieriger als ohnehin schon.

items.title: Finland suspects Russian helicopter of violating its airspace
items.teaser: Finland suspects that a Russian helicopter violated its airspace on Saturday afternoon.

items.title: Russian military-linked cargo ship could sink after drone strike in Gulf of Finland, Finnish official warns
items.teaser: Vladyslav Vlasiuk, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's sanctions policy adviser, commented on the incident in remarks to the Kyiv Independent. “Yes, quite a coincidence, isn’t it? It seems that vessels sanctioned by Ukraine for systematically supporting Russia’s military-industrial complex have a rather unfortunat

items.title: Trump threatens huge penalty for companies building data centres abroad
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a huge penalty on companies that build data centres outside the United States, as the White House seeks to maintain the country's technological edge over its rivals in the artificial intelligence sector.

items.title: Selenskyj: bislang wurden der Ukraine offiziell keine "Artikel 5-ähnliche" Sicherheitsgarantien angeboten
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte, dass der Ukraine bislang offiziell keine "Artikel 5-ähnliche" Sicherheitsgarantien angeboten wurden.

items.title: Ukraine's National Guard destroys US$15m Russian Pantsir air defence system with bomber drone – video
items.teaser: Lasar's Group, part of Ukraine's National Guard, has destroyed a US$15 million Russian Pantsir-S1 air defence system near occupied Donetsk using a heavy bomber drone.

items.title: Electricity supply situation remains difficult in Odesa region – Ministry of Energy
items.teaser: Following Russia's massive overnight attack on November 20, energy workers have managed to partially stabilise electricity supplies in the affected regions, but the situation remains difficult in the Odesa region.

items.title: Eleven injured in Russian attacks on Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson oblasts
items.teaser: Russian drone, artillery and air strikes injured 11 people in Dnipropetrovsk and Kherson oblasts on 21 November, with several people taken to hospital.

items.title: Russian forces strike railway station in Zhytomyr region, one injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a railway station in the Ovruch community of Zhytomyr region, injuring one civilian.

items.title: Verteidigungsminister: Russen brauchen mehrere Monate, um das beschädigte Teil der Krim -Brücke vom Meeresboden zu holen
items.teaser: Der Verteidigungsminister der Ukraine Jewhenij Chmara erklärte, dass die Russen mehrere Monate benötigen würden, um das beschädigte Teil der Krim-Brücke vom Meeresboden zu holen.

items.title: It will take Russians months to raise damaged section of Crimean Bridge – Ukraine's defence minister
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara said it will take Russia several months to lift and tow away the damaged section of the Crimean Bridge, which is now being inspected by divers.

items.title: Khmara prepares for international meetings in Europe in coming days – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine's Minister of Defence, Yevhenii Khmara, is preparing for a series of international meetings in Europe over the coming days.

items.title: Denmark calls for EU-wide travel restrictions on Russians following foiled assassination plot
items.teaser: In a diplomatic note circulated to EU governments on Nov. 20 and seen by Reuters, Denmark proposed suspending tourist visas for Russian nationals and ending recognition of Russian non-biometric passports throughout the Schengen Area.

items.title: Is Europe finally ready to play hardball with Putin?
items.teaser: Putting the issue of "European security architecture" on the negotiating table — especially as Europeans themselves are not at said table — only proves the point Ukraine has been trying to make for almost five years of full-scale invasion: if you don't stop Putin in Ukraine, he will go for Europe.

items.title: One person injured in Russian attack on railway station in Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: One person was injured and taken to hospital after Russian forces attacked a railway station in the Ovruch hromada in Zhytomyr Oblast, sparking a fire.

items.title: Russian forces attack Odesa region, civilian infrastructure damaged
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the Odesa region, damaging civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Finland confirms Ukraine attacked ship linked to Russian military
items.teaser: Finland has confirmed that Ukrainian drones hit the Russian ship Sparta II, which drifted into Finnish waters, and suspects a Russian helicopter violated its airspace.

items.title: Kontrolle des Verfassungsschutzes - "3:1 für Putin": Grünenpolitiker von Notz kritisiert Wahl von AfD und BSW ins Parlamentarische Kontrollgremium in Sachsen-Anhalt
items.teaser: Der Grünenpolitiker von Notz hat die Wahl von Abgeordneten der AfD und des BSW in das Parlamentarische Kontrollgremium des Landtags von Sachsen-Anhalt kritisiert. Von Notz sagte dem WDR, bei beiden Parteien stehe die Loyalität zur Bundesrepublik in ihrer bestehenden Form zumindest in Frage.

items.title: Zelenskyy explains how European countries will take part in talks with US and Russia
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said EU states will help prepare for Ukraine-US-Russia talks, with eight European representatives – the E5, EU institutions and NATO – attending.

items.title: Strikes on Kerch Bridge can force Kremlin to reconsider its position on negotiations – Ukraine at OSCE
items.teaser: The consequences of Russia's rejection of Ukraine's proposals for a ceasefire are now visible on the Kerch Bridge. Damage to the bridge could serve as a powerful reminder to the Kremlin of the need to reconsider its position and move towards constructive peace negotiations.

items.title: Russischer Frachter brennt im finnischen Meerbusen nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: Im finnischen Meerbusen ist am Samstagmorgen ein russisches Frachter nach einem Drohnangriff in Brand geraten, wie das Nachrichtenportal Yle berichet.

items.title: EU ambassador says Russia’s frozen assets will stay off the table while the bloc negotiates its next long-term budget
items.teaser: Katarína Mathernová told a Kyiv conference that adding the assets to the 2028-2034 budget talks "would make the discussion impossible," on the day the European Commission proposed another €45bn loan for Ukraine instead.

items.title: UK defence secretary visits Kyiv and discusses strengthening Ukraine's air defence with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting visited Kyiv and discussed Ukraine's air defence, anti-ballistic missiles, joint production and British aid with Zelenskyy.

items.title: Russian cargo ship catches fire in Gulf of Finland following drone attack
items.teaser: A Russian vessel caught fire in the Gulf of Finland on the morning of Saturday, November 21, after being attacked by drones.

items.title: Russia strikes Zelenskyy's hometown, killing 2
items.teaser: The attacks follow Russian President Vladimir Putin's vow of a "painful" response to Ukraine's attacks this week on the Kerch Bridge, linking Russian-occupied Crimea.

items.title: Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before our strike on Crimean Bridge – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Zelenskyy said Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before the Crimean Bridge strike, calling it a logistics route to militarise occupied Crimea.

items.title: Selenskyj zu Trump-Äußerung: "Für uns ist Putin ein Feind und Mörder"
items.teaser: Bei einem Treffen im chinesischen Shenzhen hatte US-Präsident Trump am Donnerstag seinen russischen Amtskollegen Putin als "Freund" begrüßt. Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj kommentierte Trumps Äußerung mit den Worten: "Für uns ist Putin ein Feind und Mörder"

items.title: Russia drone crashes on grounds of industrial enterprise in Poltava region
items.teaser: An enemy unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) crashed on the grounds of an industrial enterprise in the Kremenchuk district of Poltava region.

items.title: Next round of peace talks depends on US, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that holding the next meeting of negotiating teams in the Ukraine-Europe-Russia-US format depends on the American side.

items.title: Did the Court Change its Approach to Defining or Proving Genocidal Intent in Gambia v. Myanmar and Did it Get it Right? Part II
items.teaser: In the first part of this post, I looked at explicit efforts within the Court in GvM to change its approach when compared to its Bosnia and Croatia cases. In this part, I will look at the innovations that the Court made that do not depart from prior case law, but rather develop it as […]

items.title: Ukraine needs long-term security guarantees, not just during Trump's presidency – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine needs security guarantees for decades, not just for Trump's term, adding Kyiv has seen no NATO Article 5-style steps on paper.

items.title: Finland also reports drone strike on Russian vessel in Gulf of Finland
items.teaser: Finland reported a drone strike that damaged a Russian merchant vessel in the Gulf of Finland, prompting temporary airspace and maritime restrictions.

items.title: Russia moves troubled Sarmat nuclear missile toward deployment despite repeated test failures, IISS analyzes
items.teaser: Satellite imagery suggests Russia may be preparing its Sarmat intercontinental ballistic missile for combat duty, even as years of delays and failed tests raise questions about its reliability, IISS says.

items.title: Russian drone strikes private enterprise in Poltava region
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck the premises of a private enterprise in the Poltava region.

items.title: Zelensky says Ukraine has yet to see written commitments on NATO-style security guarantees
items.teaser: Responding to a question from the Kyiv Independent, Zelensky said Ukraine still needed clarity on what exactly the proposed "Article 5-like" commitments would entail.

items.title: Generalstab: fast 45.000 russische Invasoren seit Anfang November außer Gefecht gesetzt
items.teaser: In den ersten 20 Tagen des November haben die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine fast 45.000 russische Invasoren kampfunfähig gemacht, teilt der Chef des Generalstabs, Generalmajor Ihor Skybjuk, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine's NATO membership remains under discussion and would benefit both
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy said Ukraine’s NATO membership is being discussed with France and the US as the clearest security guarantee.

items.title: Zelensky says Ukraine not yet received official security guarantees equivalent to NATO article 5
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Ukraine has not yet officially been offered security guarantees equivalent to Article 5 of NATO, which provides for a collective response to aggression.

items.title: New Swedish interceptor takes aim at Russia’s jet-powered Geran drones as Ukraine prepares battlefield testing
items.teaser: The K200 is designed to engage faster attack drones that pose a growing challenge for Ukrainian air defenses. Its developer says the system has hit nine out of 10 targets in testing.

items.title: Zelenskyy names six candidates for Ukraine's US ambassador post
items.teaser: Zelenskyy names six candidates for Ukraine’s ambassador to the US, including Markarova, Kuleba, Sybiha and an experienced English-speaking military officer, as the position has remained vacant since Olha Stefanishyna's dismissal in August.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russen greifen Bahnstation in Region Sumy an
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben am Samstag, den 21. November, eine Eisenbahnstation in der Region Sumy angegriffen, schreibt der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook.

items.title: Russian drone strikes residential area in Poltava region
items.teaser: An enemy drone strike has been recorded in the Lubny district of the Poltava region.

items.title: Zelenskyy ready to meet Putin at G20 if possible
items.teaser: US partners are proposing a trilateral meeting between Ukraine, Russia and the United States before Christmas.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine’s NATO membership being discussed
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Ukraine’s membership in NATO would be the best security guarantee for the country.

items.title: AfD erhält zwei Sitze im Geheimdienst-Kontrollgremium
items.teaser: Der Landtag Sachsen-Anhalts wählt Tobias Rausch und Matthias Büttner in das Kontrollgremium für den Verfassungsschutz. Die AfD erhält zwei von vier Sitzen.

items.title: European Council president unveils proposal for reduced EU budget, retaining €100 billion for Ukraine
items.teaser: European Council President António Costa presented his own proposal for the European Union's multiannual budget for 2028-2034 on Saturday 21 November. The proposal envisages a reduction in overall spending compared with the European Commission's initial proposal but retains up to €100 billion in funding for Ukraine at

items.title: Präsident und First Lady gedenken der Helden der Himmlischen Hundert an neu gestalteter Gedenkstätte
items.teaser: Am Tag der Würde und der Freiheit haben Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj und First Lady Olena Selenska das Andenken der Ukrainer gewürdigt, die während der Revolution der Würde umgekommen sind.

items.title: Streeting urges allies to go further in supporting Ukraine through winter
items.teaser: Ukraine’s allies should provide more winter assistance than they have already announced. The United Kingdom is ready to discuss additional support with Ukraine to help it get through the winter.

items.title: Zelenskyy names 15 settlements for evacuations similar to Oleshky operation
items.teaser: Zelenskyy has named 15 settlements in Russian-occupied Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts where Ukraine proposes humanitarian evacuations similar to the Oleshky operation.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times before Ukraine struck Kerch Bridge
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Russia had carried out 109 attacks on Ukrainian bridges before Ukraine launched a retaliatory operation against the Kerch Bridge.

items.title: Russia may need a year to clear collapsed Crimean Bridge section, Ukraine says
items.teaser: The president also rejected Russian President Vladimir Putin's claims that the Crimean Bridge was not used for military logistics, pointing to publicly available footage of Russian tanks, armored vehicles, and artillery crossing it.

items.title: 20 years after his murder in Britain, Alexander Litvinenko's wife writes memoir to remind of Russian threat
items.teaser: Russia's threat to international security was apparent long before its invasion of Ukraine. One of the clearest and most chilling warnings came in 2006, with the murder of Alexander Litvinenko, a former FSB agent turned outspoken Kremlin critic. At great risk to his own safety, Litvinenko had worked

items.title: Russia killed or injured 1,144 Ukrainian children in 10 months of 2026 – already a record annual toll, UNICEF says
items.teaser: More children were killed or injured in Ukraine in the first 10 months of 2026 than in any of the previous three years. Child deaths have already surpassed the 2025 total by more than 20%.

items.title: Streeting: Putin’s attempts to divide Europe only strengthen its resolve to support Ukraine
items.teaser: European countries are united in their support for Ukraine, and the more Russian leader Vladimir Putin tries to divide Europe and turn its allies away from supporting Ukraine, the more resolute they become. Ukraine’s frontline is also Europe’s frontline in the fight for freedom and democracy.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia attacks railway station in Sumy Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a railway station in Krolevets, Sumy Oblast, on 21 November, injuring three people. President Zelenskyy confirmed the strike.

items.title: Zelensky thanks Streeting for Britain's ‘tangible steps’ in supporting Ukraine
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky met with UK Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting. Before the meeting, the head of state thanked Britain for the aid package for Ukraine announced several days earlier.

items.title: Russen verletzen in Region Donezk fünf Zivilisten
items.teaser: Infolge des Beschusses der russischen Angreifer wurden fünf Menschen am 20. November in der Region Donezk verletzt.

items.title: EU budget proposal keeps Ukraine funding unchanged as cost of Russia's war rises
items.teaser: The amount provisioned in the proposal would not cover Ukraine's budgetary needs for even one year of war.

items.title: DM Khmara says Russia will need several months to raise damaged section of Kerch Bridge
items.teaser: Minister of Defense of Ukraine Yevhenii Khmara said Russia would need several months to raise the damaged section of the Kerch Bridge.

items.title: Half of Germans want aid to Ukraine reduced or stopped
items.teaser: A total of 49% of Germans favour reducing or completely ending Germany's aid to Ukraine.

items.title: Von der Leyen condemns assassination attempt against U.S.-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark, pledges new EU security strategy
items.teaser: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has strongly condemned an assassination plot against a U.S. and Ukrainian citizen in Denmark, allegedly orchestrated by Russian intelligence services, stressing that such actions by the Kremlin will only strengthen the European Union’s resolve to support Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainische Armee trifft Brücke, Munitionslager und russische Kommandostellen
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Streitkräfte haben am 20. November und in der Nacht zum 21. November eine Brücke, ein Munitionslager und Kommandostellen der russischen Armee angegriffen.

items.title: Drones attack cargo ship heading to Russia's Kaliningrad in Gulf of Finland
items.teaser: Two drones have attacked a cargo ship heading to Russia's Kaliningrad in the Gulf of Finland.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike bridge, ammunition depot and Russian command posts
items.teaser: On November 20 and overnight into November 21, Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck a bridge, an ammunition depot and command posts of the Russian military.

items.title: Ukraine hits ammunition depot in Crimea and bridge in Luhansk Oblast
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces struck an ammunition depot in Russian-occupied Crimea, two Russian command posts in Zaporizhzhia and Donetsk oblasts, and a road bridge near Luhansk on 20 November and the night of 20-21 November.

items.title: President, First Lady honor Heavenly Hundred Heroes at renovated memorial site
items.teaser: On the Day of Dignity and Freedom, President Volodymyr Zelensky and First Lady Olena Zelenska paid tribute to the Ukrainians who were killed during the Revolution of Dignity at a renovated memorial site on the Alley of the Heavenly Hundred Heroes.

items.title: Germany news: Support for Ukraine military aid waning, survey shows
items.teaser: Nearly half of Germany's population wants to reduce military aid to Ukraine, a survey has found. Meanwhile, German consumers are set to pay more in energy bills next year due in part to the Iran war. DW has more.

items.title: Swedish Gripen authorised to shoot down Russian missile over Poland but unable to identify it
items.teaser: The pilot of a Swedish Gripen fighter jet patrolling Polish airspace during airspace violations on Friday 20 November was authorised to shoot down a Russian missile but was unable to do so due to difficult weather conditions.

items.title: Russian forces hit industrial facility in Rivne region overnight, one person injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a civilian industrial facility in the Rivne region overnight on November 21, injuring one person.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 203 Gefechte an der Front, die Mehrheit davon in Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: Am 20. November kam es zu 203 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: Russian forces strike business in Chernihiv Oblast, firefighters extinguish blaze
items.teaser: Firefighters in Chernihiv Oblast have extinguished a fire at a business following a Russian attack.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih rises to 60
items.teaser: The number of people injured in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih has risen to 60, with 28 people remaining in hospital.

items.title: Russian forces strike civilian and energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, two people injured
items.teaser: Two people, a local resident and a foreign national, were injured in Russian attacks on the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: Energy infrastructure damaged in Russian attack on Vinnytsia, power outages reported
items.teaser: A 50-year-old woman was injured in a Russian attack on Vinnytsia Oblast on 21 November. Residential buildings, a civilian business and energy infrastructure have been damaged. Power outages have been reported in Vinnytsia.

items.title: Angriff auf Krywyj Rih: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf 60
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Verletzten infolge des Angriffs auf Krywyj Rih ist auf 60 gestiegen.

items.title: Italian Arbitration Day 2026: Arbitration in the Age of Economic and Legal Disruption of Tariffs, Sanctions and Global Uncertainty
items.teaser: The fifth edition of the Italian Arbitration Day (“IAD”) was held in Rome on 11 June 2026, organised by the Milan Chamber of Arbitration and AIA ( Associazione Italiana per l’Arbitrato ). The conference focused on how international arbitration is adapting to an increasingly disrupted global environment, marked by geopo

items.title: Russian attacks kill at least 2, injure 83 across Ukraine, as strikes devastate Kryvyi Rih
items.teaser: Overnight on Nov. 21, Russia launched three Iskander-M/KN-23/S-400 ballistic missiles and 148 drones, including 87 jet-powered drones, according to Ukraine's Air Force.

items.title: Kyiv reports damage in three districts after morning Russian attack, two people injured
items.teaser: Two people were injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv in the morning of November 21. Residential buildings were damaged in three districts, while water supply disruptions were reported in five districts.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Kyjiw: Schäden in drei Stadtteilen, zwei Verletzte
items.teaser: In Kyjiw wurden bei einem russischen Angriff am Morgen des 21. November zwei Menschen verletzt.

items.title: Estonia scrambles NATO allied aircraft over drone threat
items.teaser: On the morning of 21 November, the Estonian Armed Forces warned of a possible drone threat in Ida-Viru and Lääne-Viru counties, prompting NATO allies to scramble aircraft.

items.title: Crimean bridge, which Putin uses to transport weapons, to not remain standing, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Russian leader Vladimir Putin uses the Kerch Bridge to transport large quantities of military equipment to temporarily occupied Ukrainian territory. Therefore, the bridge "will not remain standing."

items.title: Russian attack in Vinnytsia region leaves one injured, business facility damaged
items.teaser: A woman was injured in a Russian attack in the Vinnytsia region, while civilian facilities and vehicles were damaged.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 117 von 148 russischen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 117 von 148 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 20. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Russian attacks on Kharkiv Oblast leave 15 people injured, including two children
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked Kharkiv and 17 settlements in Kharkiv Oblast over the course of 20 November. The attacks left 15 people injured, including two children.

items.title: Killerroboter: UN-Konferenz endet mit Minimalkompromiss
items.teaser: Killerroboter können Ziele auswählen und Angriffe auslösen - ohne menschliche Beteiligung. Die UN sollten dafür Schranken erarbeiten. Das Wann und Wie bleibt aber unter auch wegen Widerstand aus Russland und den USA ungeklärt.

items.title: War update: 203 combat engagements on front line over past day, most in Pokrovsk direction
items.teaser: A total of 203 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 20.

items.title: Russian attacks in Sumy region leaves three injured over past day
items.teaser: Three civilians were injured in Russian attacks in the Sumy region over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Zelenskyy expects united support for Ukraine from newly elected US Congress
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urged American lawmakers to remain united in supporting Kyiv, stressing the need for missile defence systems and expressing hope that Congress will not allow Russia to prevail.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,634,860 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,730 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Air defense neutralizes 117 of 148 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 117 of the 148 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 20.

items.title: Two injured by falling Russian drone debris in Kyiv
items.teaser: Two houses caught fire in Kyiv following a Russian attack on 21 November, as the city faced simultaneous missile and drone threats after several overnight air-raid warnings.

items.title: Russische Armee verliert 1.730 weitere Soldaten an einem Tag und zwei Luftabwehrsysteme
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine belaufen sich vom 24. Februar 2022 bis zum 21. November 2026 auf rund 1.634.860Soldaten, darunter 1.730 weitere Verluste allein im Laufe des letzten Tages.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times since evening: Two killed, 55 injured
items.teaser: Since the evening of November 20, Russian forces have attacked five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times using drones and missiles. Two people were killed and 55 injured. Children were among both the victims and the injured.

items.title: Fast zehn Angriffe auf Region Dnipropetrowsk seit dem Abend – zwei Tote, 55 Verletzte
items.teaser: Die russischen Truppen hatten seit dem Abend des 20. November fünf Rayons der Region Dnipropetrowsk mit Drohnen und Raketen angegriffen.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with three ballistic missiles and 148 drones, hits recorded at 19 locations
items.teaser: Russia launched three ballistic missiles and 148 drones, including 87 jet-powered UAVs, against Ukraine overnight. Strikes were recorded at 19 locations, with the attack still ongoing as of the morning of 21 November.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian attacks in Kharkiv region rises to 11, including two children
items.teaser: The number of people injured in Russian attacks in the Kharkiv region has risen to 11, including two children.

items.title: Number of people injured in strikes on central Kryvyi Rih rises to 58, including six children
items.teaser: A 20-year-old paramedic and a seven-year-old boy were killed in Russian strikes on Kryvyi Rih. Eleven people remain in a serious condition, while dozens of buildings and emergency vehicles have been damaged.

items.title: Russian army loses another 1,730 personnel, two air defense systems in war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Russia's total combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 21, 2026, are estimated at approximately 1,634,860 personnel, including 1,730 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: More than 50 settlements without electricity in Sarny district following Russian attack
items.teaser: More than 50 settlements in the Sarny district of the Rivne region have been left without electricity following a Russian attack. Ongoing air raid alerts are preventing repair crews from quickly addressing the damage.

items.title: Russia unlikely to increase traffic on Kerch Bridge even after repairs – Pletenchuk
items.teaser: Even if restoration work is carried out on the railway section of the Kerch Bridge, Russia is unlikely to risk increasing the load on it.

items.title: Kindergarten hit in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, man injured
items.teaser: A kindergarten was hit in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia. An elderly man was injured, and a fire broke out in a neighboring residential building.

items.title: Russians kill two and injure over 20, including child, in Zaporizhzhia Oblast over past day – photo
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out hundreds of attacks on settlements across Zaporizhzhia Oblast over the past 24 hours, damaging houses, cars and infrastructure facilities. A kindergarten was also targeted overnight.

items.title: NATO fully recognizes new war domains: Cyber and electromagnetic – NSATU Commander
items.teaser: Modern warfare has moved beyond traditional domains. NATO’s Security Assistance and Training for Ukraine (NSATU) mission is therefore integrating electronic warfare and cyber defense training and equipment provision at all levels, from recruits to corps headquarters.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit a Pantsir defence system that protected Russian sites in Bryansk Oblast
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces have conducted strikes against a number of military assets in Russia and in temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine on 19 November and overnight on 19-20 November.

items.title: Finnish president says US removed Ukraine section from Trump-Xi-Putin peace declaration
items.teaser: Finnish President Alexander Stubb has revealed that an initial draft of the Shenzhen declaration included a paragraph on Ukraine before the US had it cut, and spoke about Trump's phone call to Coalition of the Willing members in Berlin.

items.title: Ukraine strikes three Russian ballistic missile launchers overnight – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has reported that Ukrainian forces struck three Russian ballistic missile launchers on the night of 19-20 November, when Russia launched a large-scale attack on Ukraine.

items.title: Energieministerium: Leistung der Reaktoren nach russischen Angriffen muss teilweise gedrosselt werden
items.teaser: Nach massiven russischen Luftangriffen in der Nacht auf den 20. November mussten die Reaktoren gedrosselt werden. Die ukrainischen Kernkraftwerke können die Stromproduktion schrittweise wiederaufnehmen, nachdem die beschädigte Ausrüstung wieder instandgesetzt worden ist.

items.title: General Staff confirms three oil tanks hit at pumping station in Russia’s Tatarstan
items.teaser: On November 19, the Defense Forces of Ukraine struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station near Almetyevsk in Russia’s Republic of Tatarstan, a key hub of the Druzhba oil pipeline. Three large oil storage tanks have been confirmed hit.

items.title: Acht Tote bei neuen russischen Angriffen auf die Ukraine
items.teaser: Nach den spektakulären Angriffen auf die Krim-Brücke hatte Russlands Präsident Putin der Ukraine mit massiver Vergeltung gedroht. Nun nahm die russische Armee ihrerseits Brücken in Kyjiw ins Visier.

items.title: Russian attack forces nuclear power plants to reduce output - Energy Ministry
items.teaser: Ukraine's nuclear power plants were forced to reduce electricity generation following a large-scale Russian attack overnight and on the morning of November 20. A gradual return to normal operations will be possible once damaged power networks are restored.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit three Russian ballistic missile launchers – Zelensky
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said that the Defense Forces hit three Russian ballistic missile launchers overnight. One was destroyed, while the results of the strikes on the other two are still being assessed.

items.title: Wissenschaftliche:r Mitarbeiter:in (w/m/d) im Öffentlichen Recht am Standort Düsseldorf der BSP (65%)
items.teaser: The post Wissenschaftliche:r Mitarbeiter:in (w/m/d) im Öffentlichen Recht am Standort Düsseldorf der BSP (65%) appeared first on Völkerrechtsblog .

items.title: Women account for 60% of new individual entrepreneur registrations in Ukraine this year – Opendatabot
items.teaser: Women registered 148,470 individual entrepreneur entities in Ukraine in January-October 2026, accounting for 60% of all new registrations during the period.

items.title: Luftwaffe wehrt 82 russische Raketen und 380 Drohnen ab
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge 82 Raketen und 380 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine in der Nacht auf den 20. November angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: Two Russian missiles, jet-powered drone crash in Poland – Defense Minister
items.teaser: Polish Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said that two Russian missiles and a drone crashed on Polish territory overnight into Friday, November 20, as Moscow launched a massive attack on Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian elite 'Rubicon' drone unit deployment site in Russian Kursk Oblast
items.teaser: The Rubicon Center for Advanced Unmanned Technologies is a sprawling Russian drone unit and the core of Russia's recently formed Unmanned Systems branch of the military.

items.title: Russian forces attack Sumy region, injuring woman and sparking massive fire
items.teaser: Russian drones struck residential buildings in the Nova Sloboda community in the Konotop district and the Hlukhiv community in the Shostka district of the Sumy region.

items.title: Merz, Koretskyi open German-Ukrainian Business Forum in Berlin
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi opened the ninth German-Ukrainian Business Forum in Berlin on Friday, with discussions focused on investment, strategic industries and Ukraine's reconstruction.

items.title: Ukraine cooperating with Poland in probe into airspace violation – FM Sybiha
items.teaser: Ukraine is working closely with Poland to assist in investigating the violation of Polish airspace during Russia's massive attack.

items.title: Illegal fuel depot with UAH 10M worth of counterfeit petrol and diesel uncovered in Kyiv
items.teaser: An illegal fuel depot where A-95 petrol and diesel fuel were produced for sale through filling stations in Kyiv and other regions has been uncovered in the Ukrainian capital. Assets seized during the operation are valued at about UAH 10 million.

items.title: Russian strikes damage Ukrenergo substations, emergency outages imposed in two regions
items.teaser: Russian attacks have caused significant damage to Ukraine's energy infrastructure, including substations belonging to NPC Ukrenergo. Emergency power outages have been imposed in the Poltava and Kharkiv regions as a result.

items.title: Smolensk’s Dorogobuzh nitrogen plant hit again as Ukraine’s drones work down Russia’s explosives supply chain
items.teaser: The plant sits near the start of the chain that ends in Russian munitions, and the same site keeps turning up on Ukraine’s target list.

items.title: Poland investigating crash of unidentified object near border during Russian attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: Polish military authorities are investigating two incidents involving possible violations of the country's airspace during Russia's massive attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20.

items.title: Chemiewerk im russischen Smolensk brennt nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: Drohnen haben in der Nacht ein Chemiewerk in der russischen Oblast Smolensk angegriffen, wie der Telegram- Kanal Astra berichtet.

items.title: Russian drone warhead removed from central Kyiv building: risk to all five storeys – photo, video
items.teaser: Experts took the barrel-shaped device to a disposal site after warning that a blast could have destroyed the five-storey apartment building.

items.title: Destinus: Firma in Hengelo feiert Angriff auf Krim-Brücke – Experten warnen
items.teaser: Der niederländische Konzern Destinus feiert den Einsatz seiner Drohne beim Angriff auf die Krim-Brücke. Kurz darauf wird die Botschaft des Landes in Kiew von Drohnenteilen getroffen. Experten sind alarmiert und fürchten Sabotageakte.

items.title: Ukraine’s air defenses down 82 missiles, 380 Russian drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defenses neutralized 82 missiles and 380 drones launched by Russian forces in an attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20. Russian strikes were recorded at 23 locations.

items.title: Ukraine updates: Kyiv targeted by missile strikes, bridges hit
items.teaser: Ukraine's capital has been struck by Russian missiles with at least 3 deaths reported. The latest strikes come after Vladimir Putin warned of a "painful" response following the Kerch bridge strikes. Follow DW.

items.title: Russian attack damages the central building of Mykhailo Drahomanov University in Kyiv
items.teaser: The central building of the Mykhailo Drahomanov Ukrainian State University was damaged as a result of a Russian attack on Kyiv on 19 November. Forty windows were shattered.

items.title: Hungary lifts veto on initial decision on the opening of negotiating clusters 4 and 5 for Ukraine
items.teaser: The Committee of Permanent Representatives (Coreper) approved the screening results of Ukrainian legislation under negotiating clusters 4 and 5 on Friday 20 November. This decision allows progress to the next stage of the procedure for their official opening within the framework of Ukraine's EU accession talks.

items.title: Opferzahl nach russischem kombiniertem Angriff auf Kyjiw steigt auf sechs Tote, 15 weitere Menschen verletzt
items.teaser: Nach einem nächtlichen russischen Angriff in Kyjiw ist die Zahl der Todesopfer auf sechs gestiegen, sagte die Sprecherin der Militärverwaltung der ukrainischen Haupstadt, Kateryna Pop, im Fernsehen.

items.title: Government directs additional UAH 81.4 bln to urgent Defense Ministry needs
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has allocated an additional UAH 81.4 billion for the urgent needs of Ukraine's Ministry of Defense.

items.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Kyiv rises to six, 15 injured
items.teaser: The death toll from Russia's overnight attack on Kyiv has risen to six.

items.title: Tote bei russischen Angriffen auf mehrere Brücken in Kiew
items.teaser: Es ist eine Attacke ins Herz der ukrainischen Hauptstadt: Russland hat in Kiew erneut Brücken beschossen und beschädigt. Mehrere Menschen wurden getötet. In Polen musste wegen des Angriffs zeitweise ein Flughafen den Betrieb einstellen.

items.title: Ukraine approves methodology for identifying strategic and critical mineral resources
items.teaser: Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers has approved a methodology developed by the Ministry of Economy and Environment for identifying mineral resources of strategic and critical importance.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 278 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, die intensivsten - bei Pokrowsk
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 278 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russia calls US ideas for NATO-style security guarantees for Ukraine "unacceptable"
items.teaser: Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov insisted the Kremlin demands acknowledgment that Ukraine will not join the Alliance before any talks on future terms.

items.title: Russia attacks energy facility in Odesa Oblast: 41,000 households without power
items.teaser: Following a morning Russian strike on a DTEK energy facility in Odesa Oblast on 20 November, 41,000 households remain without electricity as engineers wait for security clearance to inspect damaged equipment

items.title: Russia launches up to 100 missiles at Ukraine, one may have crossed into Poland – Ignat
items.teaser: During a combined attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20, Russia launched up to 100 missiles, one of which may have crossed into Polish airspace.

items.title: Two Russian Kh-101 missiles, drone, fall on Poland during Russian attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: At around 3:30 a.m. local time, Poland's Armed Forces Operational Command said its air defense systems had been activated in response to the Russian attack.

items.title: A Blue Moon over Brazil: Superior Court of Justice Opens Brazilian Courts' Doors to the Annulment of a Foreign Arbitral Award
items.teaser: Whether out of legal strategy or simply free choice, the parties’ capacity to decide keeps challenging structures that seemed to be settled. In international arbitration, party autonomy is usually the element that unsettles a landscape of apparent solidity. Consider the following choices. Two parties agreed on ICC arbi

items.title: Ukrainian air defence brought down 462 assets during massive Russian attack
items.teaser: Ukraine's Air Force has confirmed air defence intercepted or jammed 462 aerial assets by 10:30 on 20 November, including three ballistic missiles and 79 cruise missiles, as debris fell at 10 locations.

items.title: Russen greifen Eisenbahnstation in Lwiw an: es gibt zwei Tote und neun Verletzte
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff auf die westukrainische Stadt Lwiw am Donnerstagmorgen sind zwei Menschen ums Leben gekommen, es gibt auch Verletzte. Getroffen wurde die Bahnstation Sknyliw.

items.title: Kyiv death toll rises to six: eight killed, 30 injured across Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian PM reports damage to energy sites, businesses and houses in nine oblasts alongside a wastewater facility in the Ukrainian capital.

items.title: Ukrainian Air Force details overnight Russian attack: around 100 missiles and 400 drones
items.teaser: Moscow deployed ships firing Kalibr weapons alongside Kh-101s, ballistic munitions and 120 jet-powered UAVs, targeting Ukrainian power facilities and crossings.

items.title: Ukraine names targets of Russian attack: nuclear power plants forced to reduce generation capacity
items.teaser: First Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov has reported that Russian attacks on power plants and substations on 19-20 November forced Ukrainian nuclear power plants to reduce output, leaving parts of Kyiv and 10 oblasts without electricity

items.title: Russian forces attack transport and industrial infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, one injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked transport and industrial infrastructure in the Korosten district of the Zhytomyr region, injuring one person.

items.title: Russian attack kills six in Kyiv, three reportedly water utility workers, as ballistic strikes hit three Dnipro bridges
items.teaser: Russian strikes on western Ukraine, far from the front, hit both the railway and the grid, forcing emergency blackouts in three oblasts.

items.title: U.S. dollar and euro exchange rates on November 20
items.teaser: The U.S. dollar fell by UAH 0.15, while the euro lost UAH 0.04.

items.title: Russia targets Europe's largest substation in mass energy attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: The strikes hit the massive Western Ukrainian 750-kV substation, one of the most critical nodes in Ukraine's energy network, an energy official speaking under the condition of anonymity told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: Russian drone hits Zaporizhzhia Oblast Military Administration building
items.teaser: An explosion shook the southern Ukrainian city on the morning of 20 November, with early reports indicating no one was hurt.

items.title: NATO focuses on building integrated air defense ecosystem for Ukraine – NSATU commander
items.teaser: The NATO Security Assistance and Training for Ukraine (NSATU) mission is focused on building an integrated air defense ecosystem that combines ground-based systems and aviation, rather than relying solely on ballistic missile interceptors.

items.title: Situation extremely difficult: power cuts introduced in Kyiv and 10 Ukrainian oblasts
items.teaser: Ukrenergo says Russian strikes on energy infrastructure have severely disrupted Ukraine's power system, forcing emergency electricity cuts in Lviv, Zakarpattia and Ivano-Frankivsk oblasts.

items.title: Generalstab: 2150 russische Soldaten in den vergangenen 24 Stunden außer Gefecht gesetzt
items.teaser: Die Zahl der getöteten oder verletzten russischen Soldaten ist seit dem 24. Februar 2022 auf 1. 633. 130 gestiegen. Allein innerhalb von 24 Stunden beträgt die Zahl der Verluste 2150.

items.title: Drones attack chemical plant producing components for explosives in Russia's Smolensk region – media
items.teaser: Drones have attacked the Dorogobuzh chemical plant in Russia's Smolensk region.

items.title: Russian attack damages railway infrastructure, several trains delayed
items.teaser: Railway infrastructure has been damaged in a Russian attack.

items.title: Russia damages at least three businesses in Zhytomyr and Kyiv oblasts – photos
items.teaser: One person suffered multiple shrapnel injuries as transport and industrial sites came under fire, while firefighters battled blazes under the threat of repeat strikes.

items.title: EU moves towards approving Ukraine's final two accession negotiating clusters as Hungary softens stance
items.teaser: The Committee of Permanent Representatives of the EU member states (Coreper) may approve the results of the screening of Ukrainian legislation under EU accession negotiating clusters 4 and 5 on Friday 20 November, allowing Ukraine to advance in its accession talks.

items.title: Two killed, four injured in Russian attack on railway station in Lviv
items.teaser: Two people were killed and at least four others injured in a Russian attack on Lviv this morning.

items.title: A farm camera caught a flash: Russia’s missile barrage on Ukraine may have reached Poland
items.teaser: A farm security camera in southeastern Poland filmed a flash on the horizon during Russia’s mass missile and drone attack on Ukraine. An object was later found burning in a field in the village of Lipowiec.

items.title: Notfallstromabschaltungen in Regionen Lwiw, Transkarpatien und Iwano-Frankiwsk nach russischen Angriffen, auch Teile von Kyjiw ohne Strom
items.teaser: In den westukrainischen Regionen Lwiw, Transkarpatien und Iwano-Frankiwsk sind nach massiven russischen Luftangriffen in der Nacht Notfallstromabschaltungen angeordnet worden.

items.title: War update: 278 clashes on front line over past day, Pokrovsk sector hottest
items.teaser: A total of 278 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 19, with the highest number recorded in the Pokrovsk sector.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,633,130 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,150 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Explosion reported in Poland during Russian attack on Ukraine: military investigates two possible airspace violations – video
items.teaser: Polish military officials are examining two suspected airspace violations following a powerful blast in Lublin Voivodeship during Russia's large-scale attack on Ukraine. An unidentified object was found to have fallen near a village.

items.title: Russische Drohne schlägt in Krankenhaus in Charkiw ein, es gibt vier Verletzte
items.teaser: In Charkiw hat eine russische Drohne eine medizinische Einrichtung attackiert. Vier Personen wurden verletzt, teilt der Bürgermeister Ihor Terechow mit.

items.title: Russian forces strike agricultural enterprise in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an agricultural enterprise in Bereznehuvate, Mykolaiv region, yesterday using Iskander-M ballistic missiles and Shahed-type drones.

items.title: Russians attack railway station in Lviv: two killed, ten injured
items.teaser: Regional head reports at least four people hurt as Moscow targets transport infrastructure in Lviv Oblast on 20 November.

items.title: In Region Cherson drei Zivilisten verletzt, 38 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 38 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurden drei Zivilisten verletzt.

items.title: Russian forces launch over ten attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region, five injured
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked the Dnipropetrovsk region more than ten times with drones since the evening, injuring five people and damaging civilian facilities.

items.title: Todesopfer und starke Schäden in Kyjiw nach russischen Luftangriffen
items.teaser: Bei den nächstlichen massiven russischen Raketenangriffen auf Kyjiw sind drei Mitarbeiter des Wasserversorgungsunternehmens ums Leben gekommen. 15 weitere Menschen wurden verletzt.

items.title: Germany news: Merz joins German-Ukrainian business forum
items.teaser: Chancellor Merz is taking part in a forum to boost business ties with Ukraine. Meanwhile, youth protests are expected to take to the streets again. DW has the latest.

items.title: Poland investigates possible airspace violation during Russian attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: Military officials are verifying radar readings after sirens sounded in two eastern border regions and authorities warned residents of a potential strike

items.title: Russians attack Kryvyi Rih and Zhovti Vody: five injured, infrastructure facilities, petrol station and homes damaged – photos
items.teaser: Russian attacks damaged residential buildings, a bank, shops, cars, infrastructure facilities and a petrol station in several parts of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast. Firefighters extinguished all fires caused by the strikes

items.title: Russen beschießen sechs Ortschaften und töten einen Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 19. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk einen Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Russia loses another 2,150 troops in war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Russia's total combat losses from February 24, 2022, to November 20, 2026, have reached approximately 1,633,130 personnel, including 2,150 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russian attack damages railway infrastructure and causes train delays
items.teaser: Ukrzaliznytsia says several trains are running late due to ongoing threats and damage to railway infrastructure, while circular commuter train service under enhanced safety measures.

items.title: Cars and student accommodation damaged in Lviv, piece of missile found on pavement
items.teaser: Debris from Russian weapons has been discovered on two streets in Lviv, with cars, student accommodation and a house damaged. No injuries or fires have been recorded so far.

items.title: Three killed, 15 injured in Russian attack on Kyiv
items.teaser: Three people have been killed and 15 injured in a Russian missile attack on Kyiv.
